subject.title: fix(cli): bound media input file reads with per-file and aggregate budget

question: Should capability-CLI intentionally reject existing media inputs above 100 MiB per file or 500 MiB per invocation, and if so what documented upgrade behavior is acceptable?
rationale: The proposed limits alter previously unbounded CLI behavior; code review cannot determine whether that compatibility break is the desired product contract.

options.title: Approve bounded inputs and document the contract
options.body: Keep explicit limits, define their supported values and upgrade behavior, then repair the descriptor read so it cannot exceed the validated size.

options.title: Land only the TOCTOU hardening
options.body: Use descriptor-bound validation and bounded reads while preserving the existing unbounded input contract until a separate approved size-policy change exists.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Defer the patch until maintainers choose a broader media-input resource policy for capability CLI.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded inputs and document the contract
recommendation.body: Keep explicit limits, define their supported values and upgrade behavior, then repair the descriptor read so it cannot exceed the validated size.
